turns.question: Which country had the lowest average daily order revenue from 17 August to 2 October 2026, counting days with no orders from that country as zero and excluding cancelled orders, and what was that average?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no average-daily-revenue metric, so I cannot give the daily average itself; the closest metrics are Revenue (EUR) (sum of amount for non-cancelled orders, so cancelled orders are already excluded) and Average order value (EUR). By Revenue (EUR) grouped by customer country over 17 August to 2 October 2026, the US had the lowest revenue at 1,498.25 EUR for the whole period, and since every country is spread over the same days with empty days counting as zero, the US is also the country with the lowest daily average.
